purpose: Fresh chunky-silhouette art direction; not based on prior project spikes
prompt: Create an original grayscale pixel-art concept sheet for a 128×64 monochrome handheld overworld. Do not imitate any existing game or use reference art. Wide 2:1 canvas, exact 2-column by 2-row equal landscape panels, 2:1 panel proportions, separated by a narrow plain white gutter. No text, labels, UI or panel borders. Strict top-down orthographic JRPG map, no isometric angle or horizon. Direction: chunky graphic silhouettes with strong negative space, very simple hard-edged pixel clusters, large flat tonal blocks, almost no tiny detail, no drawn outlines around every object. Keep broad open paths legible and ensure landmarks read at 128×64. Design ground and objects on a visible 16×16 rhythm and leave the center open for an added 16×16 player. Grayscale only with broad values from white to black; no baked dithering, noise, grain, hatch or halftone. Upper-left cave: angular rock wall masses, a bright crystal cluster and a clear white trail. Upper-right forest: a winding white path through grouped rounded canopy silhouettes, with a log and a few fern shapes. Lower-left rural town: two compact cottages, a straight lane, simple fence, small vegetable rows and a well. Lower-right city: geometric storefront blocks around a small plaza, paving bands and a few lamps. Favor readable silhouettes and calm empty ground over realism or decoration.
